title: West Pakistan Employees Social Security Punjab Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Employees Social Security Punjab Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT V OF 1973
ACT V OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
EMPLOYEES SOCIAL SECURITY (PUNJAB
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act further to
amend the West Pakistan Employees Social
Security
Ordinance, 1965 (West Pakistan Ordinance
No. X of 1965), in
its application to the Province
of the Punjab
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th February 1973]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 26th February 1973).
No. PAP/Legis-2(5)/73/41.----The
West Pakistan Employees Social Security (Punjab Amendment) Bill, 1973 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on tae 20th day of
February 1973, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 24th day of
February 1973, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
the Punjab.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-(1) This Act may be called the west Pakistan Employees'
Social Security (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973:
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment of section 5 of
West Pakistan Ordinance X of 1965.----In the West Pakistan Employees'
Social Security Ordinance; 1965, in its application to the Province of the
Punjab, in section 5, in subsection (1), fur clause (a), the following shall be
substituted:
"(a) the Minister-in-Charge
of the Labour Department, Government of the Punjab or a person who is or has
been a Judge of the High Court or a senior officer in the service of Pakistan
not below the rank of a Commissioner of a Division or Secretary to Government,
and such person shall be the Chairman of the Governing Body;
